archive.ordering: LC_ALL=C sorted relative paths, directory entries explicit, no recursion

limitations: Already exposed development evidence only; never reserved selection or holdout.
No supplementary curator data, credentials, source clones, or replay archives included.
Original evidence references remain unchanged, including unresolved historical scratch paths.
Cards remain draft and unresolved; no consolidated final packet or partial human review request.
Archive preservation does not establish source-history, license applicability, or proof-reference completeness.
Remote durability is not established until a containing commit and remote push are verified.
